releaseNotes.text: Mejoras en el registro, la recuperación de acceso y los enlaces. Se conserva el destino elegido al iniciar sesión. Políticas disponibles en español e inglés.
Improved signup, account recovery and links. Your intended destination is preserved when signing in. Policies are available in Spanish and English.

Notifications now open the follower profile, access request, or related resource they refer to. Links preserve your destination through sign-in and show current request status. Opening a notification does not approve requests or change permissions.

Internal testing build for TDF Records 1.0.1.

Includes Android release configuration updates, Expo SDK 54 compatibility fixes, and stability improvements across bookings, events, venues, inventory, pipelines, and social tools.
